description: DiscoveryRuleSpecification is polymorphic on `kind` (ResourceGraphQuery, ApplicationInsightsTopology); the converted model keeps only the discriminator, so S.Struct strips the subtype payload on encode and decode. Add the union of the flat subtype members.
